scope: Observed capability identifiers and mappings in the current source tree; not a device support or qualification claim

sources.representation: string array on configured device record
sources.validation: internal/device accepts unique identifier strings matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$
sources.operation_mapping: none; values are reported identifiers, not executable device operations
sources.runtime_behavior: Discovery camera observation canonicalizes strings; configured voice_relay identifiers have no implemented Voice command runtime

sources.representation: JSON object keyed by capability identifier, each value has runtime status/mode/reason fields
sources.validation: producer reports status; Go runtime transports worker hello data as runtime metadata
sources.operation_mapping: none; capabilities describe inference components and never authorize actuator actions
sources.runtime_behavior: availability varies by worker mode and qualified backends; dry_run explicitly reports inference as simulated or unavailable

sources.validation: Automation receives an opaque capability map; dispatch is dry-run and does not invoke physical actuators
sources.operation_mapping: these are decision labels, not an implemented device capability-to-operation binding
sources.runtime_behavior: missing or unsupported capability is denied/unavailable; no production physical execution is established
